Game Development
  
  
2–5 years
  
  
3D Art
  
  
**We are Fatshark**
We are a critically acclaimed Swedish game development studio with about 200 experienced and skilled employees. We are most well-known for developing the Warhammer: Vermintide franchise, but have also helped develop a number of AAA titles and we launched the highly anticipated game Warhammer 40,000: Darktide.
  
  
We have grown quite a bit over the last few years, but we still embrace the same values that we started with. We want to build the best first person co-op games together, in an approachable, fun and passion-driven way.
  
  
**The role**
Fatshark is seeking an experienced Level Artist to join our talented development team building an upcoming title in Unreal Engine 5.
  
  
A Level Artist at Fatshark serves as the bridge between design and art, shaping environments from early blockout to final, shippable quality with assets created by Environment Artists and layouts created by Level Designers.
  
  
You’ll collaborate closely with the Level Team, working side by side with Level Designers, Environment Artists, Lighting Artists, Technical Artists, Sound Designers, Concept Artists and the Art Director. Your work will be central to tying visual, gameplay and audio intentions together into a cohesive and atmospheric player experience.
  
  
You will be part of a highly motivated and talented team, so you will need to be driven, creative and flexible when meeting deadlines and handling unforeseen production challenges. At Fatshark, all members of the team take part in decision making. We are a small enough group to stay agile, yet big enough to realize ambitious ideas together.
  
  
As a Level Artist, your work will sit at the crossroads of art, design, gameplay and sound, so collaboration is key. You’ll rely on clear communication, the ability to give and receive feedback, and a willingness to iterate. Although your primary focus will be level art, there will be occasions where you support other areas such as prop setup, material adjustments or smaller polish tasks related to outsourcing or internal asset work.
  
  
**This is a 12-month temporary contract onsite at our office in Stockholm with the alternative option of working on a 12-month freelance basis.**
**What You'll Do**

* Collaborate with Level Designers to understand gameplay goals, layouts and flow
* Build levels using modular kits, props and environment assets provided by the Environment Art team
* Perform set dressing to create believable, visually compelling and gameplay-friendly spaces that help guide the player
* Work with Lighting Artists, Sound Designers and Concept Artists to reinforce mood, readability and atmosphere
* Ensure levels run smoothly on all target platforms by using efficient asset placement, lighting, occlusion and culling techniques
* Participate in playtesting and iterate on levels based on feedback from art, design, audio and QA
* Provide clear feedback to Environment Artists and request new assets when needed
* Help maintain level art guidelines and contribute to improvements in tools and workflows
* Partner with Technical Artists to develop materials, basic shaders, and non-destructive procedural pipelines and tools to maximize visual fidelity and iteration speeds

**Required Qualifications**

* More than 2 years of professional experience creating level art or environment art for real time 3D games on console or PC
* Experience working inside a game engine such as Unreal, Unity or a proprietary engine
* A strong artistic eye with an understanding of composition, lighting, form, structure and visual storytelling
* Ability to read and follow concept art, as well as improvise when needed
* Understanding of level performance constraints and memory budgets
* Experience with modular building, reusability and efficient scene construction
* Strong communication skills and high proficiency in English
* Ability to meet deadlines, handle multiple tasks and collaborate we
